content_blocks.label: clause_1._DEFINITIONS
content_blocks.text: ‘Confidential Information’ means any and all information disclosed by the Disclosing Party to the Receiving Party, whether oral, written, electronic, or otherwise, which is marked as confidential or identified as such at the time of disclosure.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_OBLIGATIONS
content_blocks.text: The Receiving Party agrees to maintain the confidentiality of the Confidential Information and not to disclose it to any third party without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._EXCLUSIONS
content_blocks.text: This Agreement does not apply to any information that is already known to the Receiving Party at the time of disclosure, or that is publicly available through no fault of the Receiving Party.

content_blocks.text: Sworn before me this 22nd day of June 2024.
